findings.text: When the captured stack has fewer than two newline-separated frames, `stackWithoutTwoTopLines` becomes ''. `endsWith('')` is always true, so the async stack is never appended to `err.stack`. The old regex left the string unchanged when it didn't match, so the comparison still ran against the full stack. Example: a stack with one frame after the header line.

A single-line `dummy.stack` with no newline now gives '' (the old regex also left it unchanged, so the stack was kept). The stack is dropped, which changes behavior for engines that give a one-line stack.
